tasks.gr12-taxation-t3: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 3 — Finance: Taxation. Ask learners to determine taxable income, interpret deductions, apply simplified progressive tax tables, compare gross pay and net pay, and explain the meaning of tax calculations in realistic South African contexts.
tasks.gr12-exchange-rates-t3: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 3 — Finance: Exchange Rates. Ask learners to convert between rand and foreign currencies using buying and selling rates, include fees where relevant, interpret stronger or weaker rand movements, and justify decisions in travel or trade situations.
tasks.gr12-maps-plans-models-t3: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 3 — Maps, Plans and Models. Ask learners to interpret scale drawings, floor plans, top/front/side views and models, extract dimensions accurately, compare layouts, and solve practical spatial problems based on realistic plans and models.
tasks.gr12-probability-trial-preparation-t3: Grade 12 Mathematical Literacy Term 3 — Probability and Trial Preparation. Ask learners to use sample spaces, lists, tables and tree diagrams, calculate theoretical and experimental probability, interpret risk in context, and answer integrated trial-style multiple-choice questions across familiar CAPS contexts.
